nodes.text:
Ghana has noted reports of outbreaks in the Northern Hemisphere due to acute respiratory virus infections, particularly those caused by the Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV) in China since late December 2024. 

This virus is not a new one, unlike the case with COVID-19. https://t.co/96Q0pVMxj9
